guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice_mem rose from 1.06e7 to 1.29e8 (+1118%, z=+223.66), far above every other series, with cpu (+475%) and socket (+73%) also elevated, while all other services are flat (|z|<1). Every worst trace ends at productcatalogservice, and the error spans appear only in frontendservice, consistent with the slow downstream calls timing out there. Logs contain no warnings or errors, so the evidence is metric and trace only.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll back the productcatalogservice pod(s) to release memory, then inspect for a memory leak and set appropriate memory limits.
